verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair capability for an observability and incident-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production workspace. The AI SRE's approval gate and team-scoped API tokens are adjacent controls, not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
